description: The E92 M3 occupies a special place in BMW M history as the only generation of M3 powered by a naturally aspirated V8. Its 4.0-liter S65 engine, producing 414 horsepower and revving to an extraordinary 8,400 rpm, represents a remarkable departure from the inline-six engines traditionally associated with the M3. Paired with the E92's balanced chassis and unmistakable driving character, the result is one of BMW M's most celebrated modern performance cars. Finished in Interlagos Blue Metallic over Black Novillo leather, this 2013 BMW M3 Coupe has traveled just 7,930 miles from new. Named for Brazil's legendary Interlagos racing circuit, the deep blue metallic finish is one of BMW M's most recognizable colors, perfectly complementing the E92's muscular proportions, pronounced fender arches, and carbon-fiber roof. The understated Black interior provides a timeless contrast, creating a specification that feels equally appropriate for a driver's car or a carefully preserved collector example. Produced in March 2013, this M3 represents one of the final iterations of the naturally aspirated M3 Coupe. Its desirable Competition Package (ZCP) further enhances the driving experience with revised suspension tuning, a lowered ride height, and distinctive 19-inch Competition wheels. Additional factory equipment includes Adaptive M Suspension, M Drive, Comfort Access, heated power seats, Professional Navigation, Individual Audio, Adaptive Xenon headlights, and High-Gloss Shadowline exterior trim. Beyond its specification, what makes this particular M3 so compelling is its remarkably limited use. Accumulating fewer than 8,000 miles over more than thirteen years, it offers an increasingly uncommon opportunity to experience the E92 M3 in a condition and mileage category that few surviving examples can match. Its history reflects extended ownership, consistent BMW dealer maintenance, and a level of attention that is particularly encouraging for a vehicle driven so sparingly. Now with Enthusiast Auto Group, this M3 will undergo our comprehensive inspection and preservation process, with particular emphasis on maintaining the originality and character expected of such a low-mileage example. description: Summary: 2023 Jeep Gladiator Sport 4x4  Bright White Clearcoat, 285-horsepower 3.6L V6, four-door Crew Cab, and legendary Jeep capability with the versatility of a pickup bed. Jeep Certified Pre-Owned and ready for work or adventure. Available at Mitchell Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram in Enterprise, Alabama, where our non-commission sales advisors help you find the right vehicle without traditional profit-based commissions.  Vehicle Details: "There's something about doing things your own way that never goes out of style."  And this 2023 Jeep Gladiator Sport 4x4 understands that perfectly.  Finished in Bright White Clearcoat with a Black interior, this Gladiator isn't trying to be another ordinary pickup. It's part truck, part Jeep, and entirely its own kind of machine.  Under the hood sits the proven 3.6L Pentastar V6 producing 285 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque. But here's something that makes this particular Gladiator special: a six-speed manual transmission.  That's right. Three pedals, six gears, and a driving experience that puts you back in control. For drivers who still appreciate shifting their own gears, this Jeep delivers something increasingly difficult to find in a modern pickup.  And there's plenty more to appreciate.  The equipped Off Road Group brings rugged all-terrain tires, black aluminum wheels, sport suspension, and auxiliary switches. description: The E60 M5 represents one of the most extraordinary chapters in BMW M history. Developed during an era when BMW was deeply involved in Formula 1, the fifth-generation M5 introduced an engine unlike anything previously offered in a production BMW sedan. Its naturally aspirated 5.0-liter S85 V10 produced 500 horsepower and delivered an unmistakable combination of high-revving performance, mechanical character, and motorsport-inspired engineering. Nearly two decades later, the E60 remains the only V10-powered M5 ever produced, representing one of BMW M's most ambitious engineering achievements. Central to the E60 M5's character is its 7-speed Sequential Manual Gearbox (SMG III), developed to complement the extraordinary performance of the S85 V10. Featuring selectable shift programs and steering-wheel-mounted shift paddles, the SMG transmission delivers an engaging, distinctly mechanical driving experience that reflects BMW M's motorsport-inspired engineering philosophy of the period. Combined with the S85's remarkable 8,250-rpm redline, the drivetrain provides a driving experience unlike any other generation of M5. Finished in Black Sapphire Metallic over Black Merino leather, this 2006 BMW M5 shows an extraordinary 3,778 miles. Its exceptionally limited use is the defining characteristic of this example, placing it in a mileage category rarely encountered among surviving E60 M5s. The understated Black Sapphire exterior and Black leather interior provide a timeless specification that allows the car's exceptional preservation potential and remarkable drivetrain to take center stage. BMW production records confirm this M5 was completed at the Dingolfing assembly plant on November 2, 2005, making it an early-production example of the V10-powered generation. Its extensive factory specification includes climate-controlled front M multifunction seats, heated front and rear seats, active backrest width adjustment, Comfort Access, Head-Up Display, Professional Navigation, Park Distance Control, Adaptive Xenon headlights, Professional HiFi DSP audio, an electric glass sunroof, and rear sunshades. Brushed Aluminum Shadow interior trim complements the otherwise understated Black Sapphire over Black specification. The accompanying CARFAX documents four reported owners and no accidents or damage reported. Its history includes extended ownership in Illinois, with subsequent periods in Colorado and Illinois. Early mileage records reflect remarkably limited use, with just 833 miles documented in 2012, 1,000 miles in 2018, and 1,585 miles in late 2021. Documented maintenance includes oil and fluid services, inspections, and additional mechanical attention despite the car's limited use. Now with Enthusiast Auto Group, this M5 will undergo our comprehensive inspection and preservation process, with particular attention given to the needs of an exceptionally low-mileage S85-powered example. Our objective is to maintain the originality and character that make a car like this so special while ensuring its mechanical condition and presentation meet the standards expected of an EAG offering.
